title: The trip
reading: Brief-literal. Travel cold open, then the skiing, with the milk running joke as recurring texture rather than subject.

segments.why: cold open on faces and laughter - 'look at these silly guys doing their little program thing'
'Spencer, welcome' / 'what's up pal' / 'you didn't give me a beer' - the group assembling
airport walkway, two of them walking at camera with luggage
plane - 'you need to put that away' / 'I'm consulting right now', the funniest travel beat
night arrival at the van, closes the travel act
ridge traverse, wide scenery - establishes the mountain
chairlift with the jug in hand
the carve past camera - best pure ski shot in the bin; only window without the red pole across frame
'Whoo' at 1.2s then the jump at 3.0s - the one clear trick
POV following them down the groomer; avoids the glove over the lens at 0-2s and ~20s
'How's your milk, Spenny? Let's see if you take a good sip'
second rider passes close to the lens
the long POV run through the trees
'I'm milked out. He's milked out.' - short beat
run ends on him holding the jug up - 'He's got the milk' / 'yeah, high five'
'I became the milkman today. We created a legend.' - out on the line, before the trailing 'and now... it's over'
chugging it - 'Jesus Christ' / 'It's Jesus Boris'
'that's fucking unreal' / 'that goes so fucking hard' - top-ranked audio candidate in the bin
'oh, this is so nasty'
lounging in the chairs - lets it land and end quiet
